frozen_at_et: 2026-08-11 evening, after close, BEFORE any forward evidence exists
money: PAPER. Nothing is armed by this document. Shadow measurement only.
origin: Two independent findings from the 2026-08-11 pipeline audit pointed at ONE mechanism.
hypothesis: The engine's edge is TREND-DEPENDENT, and the correct exit shape is therefore REGIME-DEPENDENT. On low-efficiency (chop) mornings the engine loses and a pre-TP1 profit floor helps; on high-efficiency (trend) mornings the engine wins and the same floor cuts runners.

discriminator.name: ER30
discriminator.knowable_at: 10:00 ET, from CLOSED bars only. No look-ahead.
discriminator.why_not_the_archetype_library: day-archetypes.json cannot discriminate: 2026-08-04 (+$3,624) and 2026-08-07 (-$2,687) are BOTH 'gap-go' with near-identical gap_pct (0.389 vs 0.324) and prior ATR (1.198 vs 1.244). Every field that separates them (range_pct, body_pct) is whole-day = look-ahead.

WEAKNESSES: 2026-08-06 is a FALSE NEGATIVE: ER 0.29 (chop) yet +$1,465, our 3rd best day. A skip rule would have missed it.
The high-ER cohort is only 7/21 days positive -- ER identifies LOSSES, it does NOT predict wins. It is a loss filter, not an edge.
n=6-8 days in the low cohort. Thin. Neither finding is individually significant.
The ladder-by-regime split comes from a harness whose residual bias is +$384/182 positions. Small, but not zero.
ER30 and the ladder finding share the same 22-day window -- they are NOT independent samples of the same claim.

what_is_being_measured_forward_SHADOW_ON: S1: ER30 computed and logged every trading day at 10:00 ET, with the day's realized engine P&L.
S2: For every position, whether the pre-TP1 ladder floor ARMED and whether it FIRED, tagged with that day's ER30 bucket.
S3: The counterfactual the ladder cost or saved that day, priced on the calibrated harness.
gates_before_ANY_live_change: G1 n >= 25 forward trading days with ER30 logged.
G2 LOW-ER cohort: >= 8 forward days AND cumulative engine P&L on those days < 0 (the loss-filter claim reproduces forward).
G3 The ladder's sign flips between cohorts forward, in the SAME direction as the backtest (helps low-ER, hurts high-ER).
G4 DROP-BEST-DAY on each cohort separately.
G5 The 08-06 false-negative class is counted: report how many forward LOW-ER days were profitable. If >30% of low-ER days are green, the discriminator is dead and this prereg is CLOSED.
kill_criteria: G5 breach (>30% of low-ER days green) -> discriminator DEAD, closed, no variants.
The ladder's regime split does not reproduce forward -> the backtest split was noise from a shared 22-day window; ladder reverts to the single UNPROVEN forward question it already is.
Any temptation to tune the 0.35 threshold on the SAME 29 days that produced it -> forbidden. The threshold is FROZEN at 0.35. A different threshold requires a fresh out-of-sample window.
explicitly_not_licensed: No entry gate, no skip rule, no ladder arm/disarm, no params.json change, no accounts.json change. This document authorises MEASUREMENT ONLY. risky-3 remains governed by its own prereg (n>=20 days, 2 elapsed).
reporting_rule: Every forward day reported, including low-ER days that print green -- those are the ones that kill the hypothesis, so they get named.
